title: Composition of compact-support exchange with ordered Tate transport
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring killed by N and t a normalized finite Tate transport. Let X, Xprime, Xsecond and B be Noetherian schemes. Let p:X→B, pprime:Xprime→B and psecond:Xsecond→B be compactifiable, with p separated locally of finite type and quasi-compact and pprime,psecond quasi-compact. Let v:Xprime→X and w:Xsecond→Xprime give Cartesian squares over id_B. Assume N invertible on X and Xprime and fix d≥0. On K_T=A_T(d)[2d] define transport as inverse identity-pullback comparison followed by compact-support exchange and Rpprime_! of the ordered Tate comparison along v [def-amb-vector-integration-charts]. Transport along v followed by transport along w equals transport along w≫v. No trace or integration map occurs.

proof.text: Apply horizontal compact-support exchange pasting to the two given squares, with the identity base composite named id_B.

Use naturality in the coefficient and naturality of the identity-pullback comparison to move the coefficient map past the second exchange. The identity compositor unit law cancels the extra identity pullback.
Combine the three maps inside Rpsecond_! and apply ordered Tate coefficient composition.

theorem affineVectorTraceAction_comp (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {X X' X'' B : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian X'] [IsNoetherian X''] [IsNoetherian B]
    (p : X ⟶ B) (p' : X' ⟶ B) (p'' : X'' ⟶ B)
    [IsSeparated p] [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p]
    [HasCompactification p] [HasCompactification p'] [HasCompactification p'']
    [QuasiCompact p'] [QuasiCompact p'']
    (v : X' ⟶ X) (w : X'' ⟶ X')
    (sq : IsPullback v p' p (𝟙 B)) (sq' : IsPullback w p'' p' (𝟙 B))
    (sq'' : IsPullback (w ≫ v) p'' p (𝟙 B))
    (hX : IsUnit (N : Γ(X, ⊤))) (hX' : IsUnit (N : Γ(X', ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    affineVectorTraceAction A N hA t p p' v sq hX d ≫
      affineVectorTraceAction A N hA t p' p'' w sq' hX' d =
    affineVectorTraceAction A N hA t p p'' (w ≫ v) sq'' hX d
